newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Sands starts drilling in Malaysia.
newsitem.headline: Sands starts drilling in Malaysia.

text.p: Sweden's Sands Petroleum AB said on Wednesday it had started drilling oil at a block at the Bunga Kekwa field offshore Malaysia.
"Three more sites will be ready for drilling and in the first phase, within a month, 18,000 barrels of crude are expected per day," Sands said in a statement.

Sands' total production is expected to increase by about 30 percent as a consequence of the first phase. Sands owns 15 percent of the block in question, PM-3. International Petroleum Corporation IPC is the operator and owns 26.44 percent.
Other partners are Petronas Carigali Sdn Bdh with a 46.06 percent share and Petro-Vietnam Exploration and Production with a 12.5 percent share.
